taskPurpose.exactNormativeText: Destructive restore drills rebuild a clean environment, verify hashes/chains, replay migrations, restore cross-store references, re-establish collector checkpoints without hidden gaps, and measure achieved RPO/RTO.
After recovery, the system reconciles provider calls, quota reservations, workflows, inbox/outbox, alerts, collector gaps, artifacts, and audit checkpoints before active automation resumes.
If a tier cannot meet its declared recovery objective, affected capability automatically degrades and confirmed opportunity alerts are disabled until continuity is re-established.
Backup retention, deletion, legal hold, geographic location, encryption, rights constraints, and restore access are versioned and audited.
